code: library(ramp.func) Sp <- makepar_F_sin() Tp <- makepar_F_spline(tt=365*c(0:5), yy=c(1,1,1.6,.3,.7,1)) Kp <- makepar_F_sharkbite(D=260, L=300) Sa <- makepar_F_type2() F_a <- make_F_t(Sa) aa <- 1:3650 plot(aa/365, F_a(aa), type = "l", xlab = "a - Age (in Years)", ylab = expression(omega(a))) par(mfrow = c(2,1)) Fa <- make_F_a(avg = 3/365, age_par=Sa, season_par=Sp, trend_par=Tp, shock_par=Kp) aa <- 1:1095 plot(aa/365, Fa(aa), col = "darkblue", type ="l", ylab = "Exposure", xlab = "Age (in Years)") lines(aa/365, Fa(aa, d=365), col = "darkred", lty=2) lines(aa/365, Fa(aa, d=730), col = "green3", lty =3)  plot(aa/365, cumsum(Fa(aa)), col = "darkblue", type ="l", ylab = "Cumulative Exposure", xlab = "Age (in Years)") lines(aa/365, cumsum(Fa(aa, d=365)), col = "darkred", lty=2) lines(aa/365, cumsum(Fa(aa, d=730)), col = "green3", lty =3)

what: Make a Sine-based Seasonality Function — make_F_t.sin
title: Make a Sine-based Seasonality Function — make_F_t.sin
text: Return seasonal pattern \(F_S(t)\), function form $$S(t) = c \left(1+\epsilon + \sin\left(\frac{2 \pi (t-\tau)}{365}\right)\right)^p$$ \(c\) normalizing constant, \(\epsilon \geq 0\) bottom \(\tau\) phase \(p\) pw algorithm sets constant \(c\) norm $$\int_0^{365} F_S(t) dt=c$$ default norm=365.

title: Make a Time Series Function — make_ts_function
text: Build function generates time series known functions. value variable \(x(t)\) computed product four configurable elements: \(\bar x\): mean value \(F_S(t)\): seasonal pattern \(F_T(t)\): trend \(F_K(t)\): shock $$x(t) = \bar x \times F_S(t) \times F_T(t) \times F_K(t)$$ component functions specified passing parameters make_function: season_par creates \(F_S(t)\) F_season (eg, using makepar_F_sin) trend_par creates \(F_T(t)\) F_trend (eg, using makepar_F_spline) shock_par creates \(F_K(t)\) F_shock (eg, using makepar_F_sharkbite)
